title: MemoryBank tick schema — sprint_1 scaffold
description: Canonical JSON shape of one Agent tick row persisted by Track B's memory_bank.write_tick(...) into .agent_state/memory_bank/ticks/tick_<N>.json. PRODUCER: Track B (agent/core/memory_bank.py). CONSUMERS: (a) Track C sim/replay (loads ticks for backtest reconstruction), (b) Track D dashboard PLAYBACK loader (lifts a snapshot of K ticks into the dashboard_consciousness_stream payload), (c) Track B v2_boot.boot_from_ancestor (re-hydrates ancestor's last K=50 ticks per PRD §5.1 + §13). Sprint_1 publishes a SCAFFOLD shape — every field has a stable name and type, but engine-specific signal columns + chain attestation fields land in v1.1.0+ as engines come online. Atomic temp+rename write semantics per TECHNICAL_PLAN §4.6.
spec_anchors: TECHNICAL_PLAN.md §4.6 — .agent_state/memory_bank/ file layout + atomic temp+rename writer + MIGRATIONS chain
PRD.md §5.1 sub-bullet C — Tombstone NFT carries memoryBankCid
PRD.md §13 — V2 boot loader reads ancestor memoryBankCid + injects last K=50 ticks into new agent reflection context

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this tick payload. MUST equal the active registry entry. Track C / Track D readers MUST refuse to load mismatched majors.

tick.description: Monotonic tick counter from genesis. Strictly increases. Filename .agent_state/memory_bank/ticks/tick_<tick>.json.

ts.description: Wall-clock UTC timestamp when the tick was committed to disk.

agent_id.description: Agent identity string. V1 = 'genesis_v1'. V2 boot loader carries ancestor lineage.

phase.description: Current PRD §3 phase as read from on-chain PhaseManager at tick time. Pre-chain (sprint_1) = PHASE_1_INFANCY default.

narrative.description: Per-tick 1-2 sentence narrative copy per PRD §4.6. Fail-fast → template fallback (no retry). Rendered ≥28px on dashboard per PRD §8.

reflection_ref.description: Optional pointer to the reflections/<id>.md file produced this tick. Absent on non-reflection ticks.

ancestor_memory_bank_cid.description: IPFS CID of the ancestor agent's memory bank, present only on V2-boot ticks per PRD §13. Sprint_1: always absent.

lookahead_ok.description: Producer attestation that every feature used this tick has available_at ≤ game_start_time per PRD §6.8. Sprint_2+ engines MUST set true; sprint_1 stubs leave absent.

breath.description: BREATH balance after this tick's burn (PRD §6 survival mechanism).

bankroll_usd.description: Polymarket USDC bankroll snapshot. May go negative briefly during pending-settlement window.

phase_age_days.description: Days since entering current phase. Used by reflection cadence + weight-update schedule.

weights.description: Snapshot of the 6-param fusion model after this tick's weight update. Constraints α₁+α₂+α₃=1, β₁+β₂=1, w_r+w_s=1 enforced by producer; consumers may assume them.

alpha.description: [α₁ NBA技术, α₂ 盘口动量, α₃ Smart Money] inside the Rational stream. Sum to 1.

beta.description: [β₁ LLM情绪, β₂ Reddit关注度] inside the Sentient stream. Sum to 1.

rho.description: Kelly fractional scaler ρ per PRD §6.6 bet-size formula.

action.description: Decision produced this tick. Both BET and NO_BET consume BREATH per PRD §6 — NO_BET is NOT a free skip.

size_usd.description: Final clamped bet size after min(desired, breath_cap, bankroll_cap, liquidity_cap). Present iff kind=BET.

edge_pct.description: Fused-model edge over market mid at decision time. Present iff kind=BET.

no_bet_reason.description: Free-form reason text, present iff kind=NO_BET.

writer_notes.atomicity: memory_bank.write_tick MUST write to .agent_state/memory_bank/ticks/.tick_<N>.json.tmp then os.replace() onto tick_<N>.json. A crash mid-write must NOT leave a partial tick file. Verified by tests/agent/test_memory_bank_smoke.py.
writer_notes.filename_format: .agent_state/memory_bank/ticks/tick_<tick>.json with zero-padded integer (tick_0000001.json) — V1 implementation may emit non-padded names; consumers MUST sort numerically, not lexicographically.
writer_notes.migrations: memory_bank_migrations.py chains forward-only upgrades. A loader that encounters schema_version older than the registry's active major MUST run the chain to upgrade in-place before consumption.

consumer_notes.track_c_replay: sim/replay.py treats ticks/*.json as a sequence; deterministic ordering by `tick` field. Engine columns absent in v1.0.0 → replay treats engine signals as None.
consumer_notes.track_d_playback: dashboard_consciousness_stream.v0.1.0 is the CURATED playback shape, NOT this schema directly. A future builder script transforms memory_bank ticks → consciousness_stream snapshot; this contract is the upstream truth.
consumer_notes.v2_boot: agent/core/v2_boot.boot_from_ancestor(memory_bank_cid) fetches ancestor MemoryBank via IPFS, validates against this schema, and injects the last K=50 ticks (sorted by tick desc, take 50, sorted asc) into the new agent's reflection context per PRD §13.
